scripts.test: bun run --filter '*' test && bun test packages/codegen/introspection.test.ts packages/codegen/api-inventory.test.ts packages/codegen/import-sdk-schema.test.ts packages/codegen/generate-api-schema.test.ts packages/codegen/api-coverage.test.ts
scripts.api:check: bun run packages/codegen/import-sdk-schema.ts --check && bun run packages/codegen/generate-api-schema.ts --check && bun run packages/codegen/api-inventory.ts --check && bun run api:coverage:check
